spec.data: official TAIFEX 5m archive, TX, DAY and NIGHT sessions concatenated per contract; indicators reset at contract change
spec.tfBars: session-anchored clock buckets (DAY from 08:45, NIGHT from 15:00); last bucket of a session may be partial; a bucket counts only after its last 5m bar has closed
spec.direction: at the close of 5m bar i, for each timeframe: sign(close_i - EMA20 of that timeframe completed-bar closes); EMA seeded by SMA of first 20 bars of the contract segment
spec.score: sum of the five directions (-5..+5); bars lacking any EMA or ATR are ineligible
spec.event: onset of full alignment: |score_i| = 5 and score_{i-1} != score_i; direction = sign(score_i); one position at a time
spec.entry: open of bar i+1 (same session required)
spec.risk: 1.5 x ATR14 of 5m bars at bar i (true range rolled across sessions within contract)
spec.exits: stop -1R, target +2R, time exit at close of bar i+12 (60 min) or the session last bar, whichever first; a bar touching both stop and target counts as stop; a later-bar open beyond stop/target fills at that open
spec.costView: 2 ticks slippage per side + commission + tax (repo cost policy)
spec.control: for each event, a random eligible bar of the same session type and same hour-from-session-start bucket, traded in the SAME direction as the event with identical exits; 2000 draws
spec.primary: mean net R (TX) of events minus mean of matched controls; one-sided p = share of control draws with mean >= events mean; pass if p < 0.05 AND events mean net R > 0
secondary: win rate (net R > 0) events vs controls
dose response: every eligible bar traded in sign(score) direction, grouped by |score| 1..5 (overlapping, descriptive)
5m-only onsets: 5m direction flips while the four higher timeframes are not all in that direction
